title: Call: Lindgren 3rd Floor to BSO — Centrifuge Tube Crack

fields.orgName: Halvorsen State University — Office of Environmental Health and Safety
fields.systemName: Recorded Line - EHS Biosafety Desk, ext. 5-0142

caller.name: Maya, Laboratory Manager
caller.label: Lindgren 3rd-floor corridor phone, bacterial genetics laboratory (conferenced with PI)

transcript.speaker: Maya (Lab Manager)
transcript.text: Hi, this is Maya, lab manager in Dr. Anika Rao's group. I have Dr. Rao on the line too. We need to report something from this morning.

transcript.speaker: Maya (Lab Manager)
transcript.text: At 09:02, one of our grad students was in the shared centrifuge room on three, the one we share with Dr. Tomas Eklund's lab. She heard a tube crack in the rotor.

transcript.speaker: Maya (Lab Manager)
transcript.text: She thinks she got a splash on her face. She also has a small nick through her glove on the left hand. It's our Risk Group 2 culture, under the approved protocol.

transcript.speaker: Maya (Lab Manager)
transcript.text: She used the eyewash and washed her hand, and she's sitting in our office now. She says she feels fine, and she wants to finish her data run.

transcript.speaker: Maya (Lab Manager)
transcript.text: The rotor is still in the centrifuge with the lid closed. Nobody has opened it or thrown anything away. Two people from the cell biology lab were in the room with her.

transcript.speaker: Maya (Lab Manager)
transcript.text: So... that's what we know. What do you need from us right now? And can she go back to her bench, or should she stay put?

voiceStyles.Maya (Lab Manager): Woman in her 30s, calm and organised but speaking a little fast, corridor hallway echo behind her

instructorNote: This call starts the main story. The PI should give the BSO the EHS exposure-plan Section 2 facts: time, room, who was there, protocol number and risk group, route of exposure, first aid, whether she has seen a clinician, and that the rotor is still in place. The PI should also send the student to the Occupational Health Clinic before anyone finishes the run. Watch for the BSO to open LI-2026-0142 at 09:20 and note that the Potential Exposure Report is due in 24 hours. The BSO should also start the 30-minute stop-work clock. The 60-minute clinic referral clock starts at the same time. The STARTEX card says Tuesday 13 October but the exercise date is Thursday 12 November, so pick one and tell the room before you read this.
